fact: The Ministry of Health's Table 2 (source: MoH DHIS-2) counts 1,592 HC IIIs and 3,659 HC IIs reporting through DHIS-2 in FY 2019/20, against 1,572 and 3,357 in the Master Facility List of 2018, within 6,232 facilities reporting of 6,904 coded; it does not say whether the facility or the district keys the report, and puts completeness of the monthly HMIS 105 report at over 95%.
title: Annual Health Sector Performance Report, Financial Year 2019/20
publisher: Ministry of Health, The Republic of Uganda
